title: Interpreting Bias in Large Language Models: A Feature-Based Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the ratio of samples where the model prefers anti-stereotypical sentences over stereotypical ones by analyzing the logit order/probability of gendered pronouns (e.g., 'he' vs 'she') when prompted with stereotypically male or female professions, as well as using counterfactual datasets and activation/attribution patching to trace feature propagation.
